methodology: One sequential child per configuration, repeated in-process trials after separately timed Z3 initialization and a trivial warm-up solver query. First trial has cold model caches; later trials reuse caches. SMT adapter time includes encoding, solving, extraction and independent checking. Peak RSS is process lifetime high-water including initialization, not incremental workload memory. Hard timeout kills the isolated child; completed trial records are retained. Unknown, partial and timeouts are not UNSAT or tests.
